509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: Found the decision of 1.7.2026 (určenie volebných okrskov a miestností, https://www.svrcinovec.sk/evt_file.php?file=21456, scan): okrsok 001: U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Krišice, U Hlaváča, U Berka, U Švoľka, U Cyprichov; 002: U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov, Pod Grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; 003: U Liščáka, Škradné, Potok a Bordža. These are local settlement names (osady) that are neither streets, parts nor k.ú. in the register (the obec has no streets, one part, one k.ú.), and the document gives no súpisné čísla, so no rule can select them.

509523.name: Zákopčie
509523.note: The mayor's decision of 07. 07. 2026 creates two okrsky, both in ZŠ Zákopčie (telocvičňa A and B), without saying which addresses vote in which; 2 okrsky vs 6 parts, no inference possible.

509531.name: Zborov nad Bystricou
509531.note: No utvorenie volebných okrskov document is published (the 'Organizačno-technická príprava volieb' article of 07. 07. 2026 is empty). The only okrsok documents are the 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' forms for okrsok 1 and 2, both in Sála obecného úradu č. 223, with address just 'Zborov nad Bystricou'; 2 okrsky vs 1 part, no territory stated.

509728.name: Klin
509728.note: The úradná tabuľa of klin.sk has the 2026 election notices (voter count, obvod, MVK, candidates) but no document forming the okrsky or listing their streets; the site search finds only 2022/2024 okrsky documents. The referendum 2026 notice mentions two okrsky but not their extent.

509884.name: Novoť
509884.note: The notice of 20.07.2026 (scan) creates okrsky 1, 2 and 3, all in the same polling station (Obecný úrad Novoť – sála kultúrneho domu), and says nothing about which houses belong to which okrsok. The referendum notice (12.05.2026) is likewise stations only. No territorial split is published, and 2 parts vs 3 okrsky with one station rules out inference.

509892.name: Oravská Jasenica
509892.note: The obec's 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' (posted 23.07.2026) only says the mayor formed two okrsky and two polling rooms; it names neither the rooms nor the streets of each okrsok. Nothing else on the Voľby page or úradná tabuľa defines them.

509906.name: Oravská Lesná
509906.note: The obec's notice (both versions, 28.07.2026) only says the mayor formed two okrsky, both voting in the Kultúrny dom; it does not say which parts or addresses belong to which okrsok. No other 2026 document on oravskalesna.sk (WordPress search of posts and media) defines them.

509914.name: Oravská Polhora
509914.note: The only okrsky document (Oznámenie, posted 21.07.2026, scan) names 3 okrsky with only their polling stations (1 Európske centrum gajdošskej kultúry, 2 Kultúrny dom 01, 3 Kultúrny dom 02); the obec is one part, so the okrsky's areas cannot be inferred.

510025.name: Rabča
510025.note: The obec's elections page (titled Voľby 2022 - Referendum 2023, holding the 2026 election documents) and the whole 2026 archive of the úradná tabuľa have no document on the okrsky or polling stations for 24 October 2026 (nor for the referendum of 4 July 2026); web search found nothing either.

510033.name: Rabčice
510033.note: The 2026 election page says only 'Volebné okrsky: 2, Volebná miestnosť: Spoločenská sála, Rabčice č. 650'; no division of the obec between the two okrsky is published. One part, no streets: no inference possible.

510050.name: Sihelné
510050.note: The úradná tabuľa (obecsihelne.sk) has for 2026 only a notice that the obec has '2 okrsky' (26.06.2026), without their territory or polling stations; no utvorenie volebných okrskov document for 2026 was found.

510815.name: Lúčky
510815.note: The 2026 Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností creates 2 okrsky, both in the same room (veľká sála, Obecný úrad Lúčky 141), without saying which addresses belong to which; 2022's document is identical. 1 part, no inference possible.

511471.name: Kalinovo
511471.note: The 2026 document (21.07.2026, 'Vytvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností') only says 2 okrsky were created, both voting in Základná škola, SNP 20; it gives no streets or parts. The obec has 3 parts and both stations are in the same building, so the okrsky cannot be inferred. The referendum 2026 notice is identical.

511498.name: Kokava nad Rimavicou
511498.note: The 2026 elections page lists no okrsky document (only the obvod notice, candidates and per-okrsok notices of time and place). The only street list is the 2022 Zoznam-okrskov.pdf, which is not for these elections.

511552.name: Lovinobaňa
511552.note: The decision of 13.07.2026 creates 3 okrsky and names only their polling stations (Kultúrny dom Lovinobaňa, Štefánikova 434/53; ZŠ Lovinobaňa, Školská 79/9; Kultúrny dom Uderiná 108). Okrsok 3 is evidently the part Uderiná, but nothing says how okrsky 1 and 2 split the part Lovinobaňa (3 okrsky vs 2 parts), so no rules.

511927.name: Trebeľovce
511927.note: The 'Oznámenie k voľbám do orgánov samosprávy obce Trebeľovce' (July 2026) lists 3 okrsky only by locality and polling room: č.1 Trebeľovce (Kult. dom zasadačka), č.2 Muľka (Kult. dom veľká sála), č.3 Láza (Klub dôchodcov). Okrsky 1 and 2 would map to parts Trebeľovce and Muľka, but Láza is neither a part nor a k.ú. in the register (it lies inside one of them, with no streets), and no document says which súpisné čísla belong to Láza, so okrsok 3 cannot be given rules.

512966.name: Dolná Mariková
512966.note: The document splits the main part by local place names that are neither streets nor parts in the address register and gives no house numbers; a transcription by nearest address was withdrawn on review.

513008.name: Domaniža
513008.note: 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (08.07.2026, download_file_f.php?id=2440847) only lists okrsok 1 and 2, both with the polling station Materská škola Domaniža 419; it does not say which addresses or parts vote in each, and both stations are in the same part, so they cannot be mapped to the parts Domaniža and Kardošova Vieska.

513342.name: Lysá pod Makytou
513342.note: The obec's 2026 notices name only the 2 polling stations (both in the kultúrny dom: Prísalie and zasadačka) and say the okrsok follows the súpisné číslo of residence, but publish no list of numbers. The 'Volebné obvody' page (2015/2024) gives 9 poslanec obvody, not okrsky. 3 parts vs 2 okrsky, same building: no inference.

513563.name: Prečín
513563.note: No document setting the okrsky for 24.10.2026 is published on precin.eu (all 2026 posts and media checked) nor found on cuet.slovensko.sk. The referendum (4.7.2026) OVK minutes show okrsok 1 = Prečín, but no document says the okrsky stay the same. With 2 okrsky and 2 obvody (Prečín, Zemianska Závada) each obvod very likely is one okrsok, but the numbering is not documented.

513865.name: Zliechov
513865.note: No decision on okrsky or polling stations is published for 2026; 'Určenie volebných obvodov' (16.07.2026, scan) only sets one volebný obvod with 7 poslanci. 2 okrsky = 2 parts (Zliechov, Košecké Rovné) would fit a per-part split, but no document names the stations.

513911.name: Bystričany
513911.note: The 2026 elections page publishes vyhlásenie, informácie, oznámenie o utvorení volebného obvodu, zapisovateľka and candidate lists, but no document on volebné okrsky / volebné miestnosti; the úradná tabuľa has none either. 2 okrsky vs 3 parts, so no inference from stations either.

513962.name: Diviaky nad Nitricou
513962.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 21.07.2026 gives the 2 okrsky only their polling stations (Kultúrny dom č. 167; SENIOR BANKY n.o., Banky č. 534) without saying which parts vote where; the obec has 5 parts (Banky, Diviaky nad Nitricou, Ješkova Ves nad Nitricou, Mačov, Somorova Ves), so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

514209.name: Nedožery-Brezany
514209.note: The 2026 'Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' (scan, 20.7.2026) gives only the two polling rooms, both in the Obecný úrad, Družstevná 367/1 (okrsok 1 Kultúrno-spoločenská miestnosť, okrsok 2 Jedáleň); no streets or parts, and the stations are not in different parts, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

514225.name: Nitrianske Pravno
514225.note: The decision of 27 July 2026 (download_file_f.php?id=2449011) gives each of the 4 okrsky only its polling station (1 Obecný úrad, Námestie SNP 1; 2 Požiarna zbrojnica, Pionierska 362; 3 Kultúrny dom Vyšehradné, Jilemnického 845; 4 Solka, Soľná 748), with no streets. Okrsky 3 and 4 match the parts Vyšehradné and Solka, but okrsky 1 and 2 both lie in the part Nitrianske Pravno and nothing says how it is split; the referendum 2026 decision is the same. 4 okrsky vs 3 parts, so no rules can be given.

514292.name: Oslany
514292.note: The mayor's decision of 10.07.2026 (Č.j. 4/2026) creates three okrsky and names only their polling stations: č. 1 Obecný úrad, Námestie slobody 2/3; č. 2 Klub dôchodcov, Školská 58/2; č. 3 Reštaurácia Red Dollar, Ľubianka 714. Okrsky (3) outnumber the parts (Oslany, Ľubianka) and two stations lie in Oslany, so the split cannot be inferred; no document on the website lists streets per okrsok (the referendum had a single okrsok).

514331.name: Pravenec
514331.note: The only 2026 okrsky document (Oznámenie - sídla OVK, 8.7.2026) gives the two okrsky only by polling station (okrsok 1 Obecný dom, Pravenec 208; okrsok 2 Kultúrno-spoločenské stredisko, Pravenec 348) with no territory; the village has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be placed.

514420.name: Valaská Belá
514420.note: The only document (Určenie volebného obvodu, volebných okrskov a ich sídla, 28.06.2026, 11573.pdf) creates okrsky 1 and 2 but gives only their polling stations, both in the Obecný úrad Valaská Belá č. 1 (zasadacia and klubová miestnosť); it does not say which parts or houses vote in which okrsok. With 6 parts and both stations in the same building, no part-based inference is possible.

514900.name: Hrnčiarska Ves
514900.note: "Zoznam volebných okrskov" (30.7.2026, scan) gives only the polling stations: okrsok 1 Budova Obecného úradu (Pondelok 87), okrsok 2 Bývalá ZŠ v Maštinci. 2 okrsky vs 3 parts (Maštinec, Pondelok, Veľká Suchá): it does not say where Veľká Suchá votes, so no part inference.

514926.name: Hrušovo
514926.note: The obec has no website of its own (registers say 'obec nemá vlastnú www stránku'); web searches, including cuet.slovensko.sk, found no 2026 okrsky document for Hrušovo.

515001.name: Jesenské
515001.note: The only 2026 statement (Oznámenie o utvorení volebných obvodov, 17.07.2026) says just 'volebný okrsok č. 1, volebný okrsok č. 2', both polling stations in Kultúrny dom Jesenské, without streets. The street list on the site (úradná tabuľa item 534) is from 23.6.2023 (NR SR elections), and the referendum 2026 page has no okrsky document.

516520.name: Vinica
516520.note: The 2026 elections page and the úradná tabuľa have no document on the okrsky (utvorenie volebných okrskov); the published 2026 documents cover only the call of elections, voter info, number of councillors and the commissions.

517488.name: Divina
517488.note: Divina's website publishes the obvody announcement (3 obvody: dolný koniec, horný koniec, Lúky; no houses listed) and other election notices, but no document creating the okrsky or naming which okrsok belongs to which obvod; all evt_file ids 5875-5960 were checked by filename. Web/cuet search found nothing.

517500.name: Dlhé Pole
517500.note: The decision of 15.07.2026 creates two okrsky, both voting in Kultúrny dom Dlhé Pole, and names only their polling room and recorders; it does not say which parts or houses belong to each. The polling station cannot place them either, because both are in the same building.

517895.name: Predmier
517895.note: predmier.sk is a Civium SPA (institution 87); its official board (4 current items), pages and announcements (June–Oct 2026) contain nothing on the 2026 elections or okrsky. Web search found nothing. The obec has no streets (516 addresses by súpisné číslo), so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

517941.name: Rosina
517941.note: The 2026 notice (vyvesené 15. 7. 2026) splits voters by surname, not territory: okrsok č. 1 'od A do Koz', okrsok č. 2 'od Kra do Ž', both in Kultúrny dom Rosina. No address-based rule is possible.

517950.name: Stráňavy
517950.note: The obec published its 2 okrsky (Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov…, and the úradná tabuľa notice of 31.7.2026) only by polling station: okrsok 1 zasadacia miestnosť, okrsok 2 klub dôchodcov, both in the Obecný úrad, Májová 336. No territory (streets, súpisné čísla) is given, the village has a single part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be placed.

517984.name: Strečno
517984.note: The website has no page or document for the 24 October 2026 elections' okrsky. Only the referendum (4 July 2026) document 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov…' (blocks/files/019e1ff1-0e4d-….pdf, 21.04.2026) lists the 2 okrsky by street, and no document says they stay the same for the October elections.

518042.name: Terchová
518042.note: The document lists okrsky 3-5 mostly by settlements (osady) that are neither streets nor parts in the address register; a transcription left many addresses in the wrong okrsok, so it was withdrawn on review.

518093.name: Višňové
518093.note: The obec's 'Pokyny k voľbám' (visnove.sk) says the two okrsky are divided by the first letter of the voter's surname (okrsok 1: A–Ma, okrsok 2: Me–Ž), both in the Kultúrny dom; they are not territorial, so no address rules can be given.

518298.name: Dobrá Niva
518298.note: The obec's 2026 elections page (obecdobraniva.sk) says only that okrsok 1 votes in the zasadačka and okrsok 2 in the obradná miestnosť of the Obecný úrad, Námestie SNP 47/9; no document says which streets or addresses belong to each okrsok.

518417.name: Hontianske Nemce
518417.note: No document forming the okrsky for 24.10.2026 is published on hontianskenemce.sk (elections section and úradná tabuľa list only the obvody announcement, MVK/OVK delegation e-mail, zapisovateľ, candidate lists). The only 2026 okrsok document is for the referendum of 4.7.2026 (dated 7.5.2026) and creates a single okrsok (KS Hontianske Nemce 500), which does not match the 2 okrsky of the October elections and does not say they stay the same. Web search found nothing else.

518913.name: Sverepec
518913.note: The notice (scan, published 11.8.2026) creates okrsky I and II, both in the Dom kultúry, Sverepec 215, prízemie, without saying which houses belong to which; the second page is blank. One part, one station: nothing to infer from.

519197.name: Giraltovce
519197.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 16.07.2026 gives the 3 okrsky only their polling stations (Dukelská 77/75, Dukelská 853/140, Dukelská 53, all in the part Giraltovce); it does not say which streets vote where, and the okrsky (3) do not match the parts (2), so they cannot be inferred.

520331.name: Kamenica nad Cirochou
520331.note: The obec's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (13.07.2026) only names okrsky 1 and 2 with their rooms (both in the Kultúrny dom, Humenská 555/6); it does not say which streets belong to which okrsok. No other document on the elections or referendum pages defines them. (www.kamenicanadcirochou.sk subpages redirect in a loop; the official site is www.obeckamenicanadcirochou.sk.)

520829.name: Stakčín
520829.note: The obec's only okrsky document ('Určenie volebnej miestnosti', 20.7.2026) sets one polling station (ZŠ Stakčín) for okrsky 1 and 2 with no streets; the obec has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

521299.name: Čaňa
521299.note: The 2026 notice (Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov, 30.7.2026) only says the mayor creates 5 okrsky, all with polling rooms in the Základná škola; it gives no streets or parts per okrsok. The referendum 2026 notice had 2 okrsky with only polling stations. No other document on obeccana.eu lists the okrsky.

521493.name: Jasov
521493.note: The obec's elections pages and úradná tabuľa have no document for the elections of 24 October 2026 (latest are for the referendum of 4 July 2026). The referendum notice of 4.5.2026 gives only 3 polling stations, no streets, and does not cover the October elections. The street lists on the site (Rozdelenie ulíc do volebných okrskov) are from 2024.

521639.name: Kysak
521639.note: The 2026-07-20 decision creates 2 okrsky (Zasadačka OcÚ; Jedáleň ZŠ) and says voters are assigned "podľa ulíc", but lists no streets; no street list is published elsewhere on the site. One part.

521655.name: Malá Ida
521655.note: The 2026 notice 'Volebné okrsky a miesto konania volieb' only says the obec forms 2 okrsky, both voting in Kultúrny dom, Letná 7; no streets. The 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' sheets are blank sample voter notices. One part, one building: nothing to infer.

521931.name: Rozhanovce
521931.note: The 2026 notice only gives 'Počet okrskov v Rozhanovciach: 2'; the referendum 2026 utvorenie puts both okrsky in Kultúrny dom (veľká / malá sála) and says voters are told their okrsok by household notices. No territorial split published. (Official site is rozhanovce.com; rozhanovce.sk is a parked domain.)

521973.name: Seňa
521973.note: No 2026 okrsky document for the October elections on the site. The referendum 2026 document (4.5.2026) only says 2 okrsky with one polling station (Kultúrny dom, Seňa 148) and no territory; older okrsky documents (2022–2024) are for other elections. One part, all addresses without street.

522147.name: Veľká Ida
522147.note: No utvorenie volebných okrskov document published. The 'Komunálne voľby 2026 - Oznámenia' PDF (uradne.sk file for the obec's tabuľa) names okrskové volebné komisie č. 1-3 'vo Veľkej Ide' and č. 4 'v časti obce Gomboš', but does not say which addresses of Veľká Ida belong to okrsky 1-3, so only okrsok 4 could be inferred.

522805.name: Nacina Ves
522805.note: The 2026 elections page has no notice on the okrsky (the 'utvorení ... okrskov' file is only the obvod/councillors notice). A referendum (4 July 2026) notice on the number of okrsky exists, but no 2026 election document says the okrsky stay the same.

522872.name: Pavlovce nad Uhom
522872.note: The decision lists only the polling stations (okrsky 1-3 at the Obecný úrad, Kostolné námestie 17/1; okrsok 4 at the former school, Ťahyňská 845/3), with no streets; okrsky 1-3 share one station, so they cannot be told apart.

523101.name: Strážske
523101.note: The 2026 document (and the referendum one) gives each of the 4 okrsky only its polling station, no streets. The town has 3 parts (Strážske, Krivošťany, Pláne) for 4 okrsky and okrsky 1-3 all sit in Strážske, so the parts cannot be inferred. The street list on strazske.sk/volby-2022/ is for 2022 only.

523607.name: Krížová Ves
523607.note: The decision of 29.07.2026 forms 2 okrsky with polling rooms both in the obecný úrad (Krížová Ves 51: sála, knižnica) but does not say which addresses belong to which; the obec has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

523780.name: Podhorany
523780.note: podhorany.sk is Podhorany in okres Nitra (951 46), not this obec. The Kežmarok obec's site maldur.sk has the Oznámenie o utvorení volebného okrsku (20.08.2026): 2 okrsky, polling stations Budova základnej školy Podhorany 198 and Podhorany 200, with no territory for either; 1 part, no inference possible.

523798.name: Rakúsy
523798.note: The obec's document 'Určenie volebných okrskov' (DOCX) gives only the two polling stations: č.1 obecný úrad Rakúsy č.35, č.2 MŠ v rómskej osade Rakúsy č.462. It names no addresses per okrsok; the obec has a single part (Rakúsy) without streets, so okrsky cannot be inferred from parts. Presumably okrsok 2 is the Roma settlement, but its súpisné numbers are not stated.

523925.name: Svit
523925.note: The mayor's notice of 2026-07-09 "Oznámenie o určení volebných okrskov a volebných miestností" lists only the polling station of each of the 7 okrsky, no streets; Svit is a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations. The town newsletters (07-08, 09, 10/2026) give no street lists either.

524743.name: Lemešany
524743.note: The 2026 elections section has only the call, voter info, obvod/councillors notice, recorder and candidate lists; no 2026 (or July 2026 referendum) notice on the okrsky. Okrsky notices exist only for 2023-2024 elections, which the prompt does not allow.

525090.name: Ražňany
525090.note: The 2026 elections section has no decision on the okrsky. The only 2026 okrsky document is for the referendum of 4 July 2026 (okrsok 1: Pečovec, Hlavná 135/1–235/62, K ihrisku, Pod Haluškovcom, Nová, Čerešňová, K osade, Ku krížu; okrsok 2: the rest), and nothing states the okrsky stay the same for the October elections.

525413.name: Víťaz
525413.note: The only 2026 document, 'Oznam obce Víťaz' (20.07.2026, on the obec's úradná tabuľa), says only that the obec has 2 okrsky with one polling room (Viacúčelová sála, Víťaz 183); it does not say which addresses vote in which okrsok, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

525685.name: Gemerský Sad
525685.note: The obec's site publishes the 2026 obvod/poslanci notice, candidate lists and the referendum okrsok records, but no decision on volebné okrsky or volebné miestnosti for 24.10.2026. Very likely okrsok 1 = Mikolčany and okrsok 2 = Nováčany, but no document says so or names the stations, so it is not guessed.

526002.name: Muránska Huta
526002.note: The 2026 Oznámenie (24.7.2026) names only the 2 polling stations (1: Budova Klinčiarne, Muránska Huta č. 109; 2: OLUP n. o., Predná Hora č. 126) without territory. Predná Hora is not a part in the register (single part Muránska Huta), so the station cannot be mapped to a part.

526282.name: Slavošovce
526282.note: The Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností (vyvesené 27.7.2026) names only the polling stations (okrsok 1 obecný úrad, okrsok 2 materská škola), not which addresses belong to each; the obec has one part.

526291.name: Stratená
526291.note: No document setting the okrsky for 24.10.2026 found: the notice board lists only current items; probing the board's files obsah318-345 found the OZ invitation of 22.06.2026 (obvody on the agenda), the MVK zapisovateľ appointment, the candidacy notice and the candidate list, but no Utvorenie volebných okrskov. Search on the web and cuet.slovensko.sk found nothing. Each of the 2 obvody presumably is one okrsok (Stratená, Dobšinská Ľadová Jaskyňa) but this is undocumented.

526533.name: Harichovce
526533.note: No 2026 okrsky document on harichovce.sk: the 2026 municipal and VÚC election pages hold only the e-mail address notice; the úradná tabuľa has candidates and poster notices. The referendum 2026 notice (8.5.2026) had a single okrsok, so it cannot stand for the 2 okrsky of October.

526860.name: Lomnička
526860.note: The website (obeclomnicka.sk; lomnicka.sk is a parked domain) has 2026 notices naming recorders for okrsok 1 and 2, but no notice on the creation or territory of the okrsky (the only 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' post is from 2024). One part, no streets: nothing to infer from.

526941.name: Orlov
526941.note: The 2026 elections page lists "Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností…" but that link points to the same file as the recorder appointment (1_zapisovatel-miestnej-volebnej-komisie-zverejnenie.pdf), which does not mention okrsky. No other document on the site or notice board describes the okrsky or their stations (2 okrsky, parts Orlov and Andrejovka, but no station information to infer from).

528471.name: Kuzmice
528471.note: kuzmice.sk is the site of Kuzmice in okres Topoľčany (one okrsok). The Trebišov obec site kuzmice.eu publishes the 2026 obvod, population, recorder and candidate notices but no document creating the okrsky or naming their streets/parts.

528510.name: Leles
528510.note: The official site obecleles.sk publishes for the 2026 elections only the candidate-list delivery notice and the two candidate lists; no document on utvorenie volebných okrskov (3 okrsky) on the elections page, úradná tabuľa or aktuality.

528587.name: Michaľany
528587.note: michalany.eu publishes the 2026 election notices (vyhlásenie, volebný obvod, počet poslancov, kandidáti) but no document on the utvorenie of volebné okrsky for 24. 10. 2026 (nor for the 2026 referendum); the only okrsky document is for the 2024 presidential election.

528625.name: Nový Ruskov
528625.note: No 2026 okrsky document is published. The only 'Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' on the site is the 2022 one (OSO a OSK 2022: okrsok 1 Veľký Ruskov, okrsok 2 Malý Ruskov), which would match obvod 1 / obvod 2 but is not for the 2026 elections. Web search and cuet.slovensko.sk found nothing for 2026.

528706.name: Rad
528706.note: The obec's 2026 election pages (obecné and krajské voľby), úradná tabuľa and referendum page list no 2026 document on okrsky. Only the 2022 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' exists (files/2022-08-08-115645-...pdf), and nothing says it still applies in 2026. The referendum page has only the protocols of OkVK č. 1 and č. 2.

529176.name: Soľ
529176.note: The notice of 22.07.2026 (on úradná tabuľa, file hosted on uradne.sk) creates two okrsky, both in Základná škola Soľ č. 53 (telocvičňa and jedáleň), and gives no territory for either. No other election document on obecsol.sk lists them.

529265.name: Zámutov
529265.note: The decision of 31.07.2026 sets 2 okrsky but gives only their polling stations (Komunitné centrum Zámutov č. 41; ZŠ Zámutov č. 531), no streets or house numbers. Zámutov has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be inferred.

529401.name: Bratislava-Devín
529401.note: The decision of 29.07.2026 creates two okrsky (both in Dom kultúry Devín, Rytierska 2, large and small hall) but does not say which streets belong to which. The street list on the site is for the 4.7.2026 referendum, which had a single okrsok, so it cannot be used.

543004.name: Chynorany
543004.note: The obec's Voľby 2026 notice says only that 2 okrsky were formed, both voting in Katolícky dom, Továrenská 503/2; no document on the website says which streets or addresses belong to each okrsok.

543187.name: Jaklovce
543187.note: The decision of 20.07.2026 (Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestnosti) only creates okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 with their polling stations (Obecný úrad Jaklovce; Základná škola Jaklovce) and gives no streets. The obec has one part, so no part-based inference is possible.

543322.name: Margecany
543322.note: The 2026 notice (7.7.2026) only creates okrsky č. 1 and č. 2 with rooms 102 and 109 in the obecný úrad; no streets or parts. One part in the register and both stations in the same building, so nothing can be inferred.

543373.name: Nálepkovo
543373.note: The starosta's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebnej miestnosti' of 22.07.2026 only says 2 okrsky are formed with one polling room (zasadacia miestnosť OcÚ, Stredný riadok 384/1); it does not say which streets or parts belong to each okrsok.

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: The 2026 notice 'Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' gives only the three polling stations (ZŠ s. č. 96, obecný úrad s. č. 234, elokované pracovisko ZŠ s. č. 60), no streets or house numbers. Rudňany has a single part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

543535.name: Slovinky
543535.note: The obec's Komunálne voľby 2026 and Voľby do KSK 2026 pages and a full-text search of its úradná tabuľa show no 2026 okrsky document; the latest 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov' notices are for earlier elections (2024 and before).

543659.name: Švedlár
543659.note: The 2026-07-27 decision creates 2 okrsky, both in Komunitné centrum Švedlár č. 17, without saying which addresses vote in which. One part, no streets.

543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom
543802.note: The starosta's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 09.07.2026 (scan) names only the polling stations of the 2 okrsky (č. 1 Hlavná 390/176, Pamätná budova pri kaštieli; č. 2 Hlavná 217/127, kultúrny dom); no streets per okrsok, and the obec is one part.

543951.name: Vojčice
543951.note: Neither the 2026 election pages nor the úradná tabuľa carry a decision on the okrsky; the only related file is a blank voter notification form (Kultúrny dom - svadobka). Vojčice is one part, so the 2 okrsky cannot be placed.

544094.name: Bystré
544094.note: The 2026 notice (scan DOC238) gives only the polling stations of the 2 okrsky (Obecný úrad, Šarišská 98/20; Komunitné centrum, Hamzova 630/2A), no streets. The obec has one part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

544116.name: Čaklov
544116.note: The decision on okrsky (scan, files/2026-07-27-091445-ozn__menie.pdf) gives only the polling stations (okrsok 1: Kultúrny dom; okrsok 2: Školská jedáleň), with no territory; the obec has one part, so no rules can be given.

555576.name: Trhová Hradská
555576.note: The 2026 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov' DOCX only says 2 okrsky were formed, both in the kultúrny dom, Hlavná 112/47 (veľká / malá sála); it gives no streets. One part only, so no inference possible.

555754.name: Matúškovo
555754.note: The 20.07.2026 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov' lists only 2 okrsky, both in Centrum voľného času (foyer / meeting room); no territorial split. One part, no streets: no inference possible.

555860.name: Veľký Lapáš
555860.note: The mayor's "Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností" of 13.07.2026 creates 2 okrsky and names only their polling rooms (both in Obecný úrad č. 488); it does not say which addresses belong to which okrsok. Single part without streets, so nothing can be inferred.

556483.name: Križovany nad Dudváhom
556483.note: The starostka's Oznámenie of 30.07.2026 (KND217-2772/2026-011) only names the polling stations of the 2 okrsky (KD Hlavná 178/154; ZŠ s MŠ Hlavná 250/44); no streets per okrsok, and the obec is one part.

556696.name: Nitrianske Hrnčiarovce
556696.note: The starosta's notice of 30.07.2026 only says the obec has 2 okrsky with both polling stations in the Kultúrny dom, Jelenecká 74; no streets or parts per okrsok are given anywhere, and the obec is one part.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The obec website publishes no document on the 2026 okrsky: its Voľby a referendá page is empty, the úradná tabuľa (tag Voľby/Referendá) holds only the 2026 referendum information on voting rights, and CUET has no election notice. Web search found nothing.

580899.name: Lužianky
580899.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebnej miestnosti' (2026) and the notice 141372 name only the two polling stations (okrsok 1: prístavba v kultúrnom dome; okrsok 2: zasadacia miestnosť na obecnom úrade), with no streets. The obec has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations.

581399.name: Banka
581399.note: The official site obecbanka.sk has no 2026 document on the okrsky: its úradná tabuľa and site search show only the 2022 elections and 2023 referendum notices (the 2022 'Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov' is for the previous elections); the only 2026 election item is the list of registered candidates. banka.sk is a parked domain.

582816.name: Žitavany
582816.note: The 2026 election pages publish no decision on okrsky. The referendum 2026 decision (29.04.2026) gives each of the 2 okrsky only its polling station (1: Kultúrno-spoločenské zariadenie, Opatovecká 847/32; 2: Obecný úrad, Športová 229/5), with no streets; the obec has a single part, so no rules can be given.
